changes: Selected both USA/CHN directions and sorted source rows. Normalized previous-residence flow fields separately; numerical strings unchanged.

field_definitions: Original source-row index, preserved in the complete query.
field_definitions.Destination ISO: Destination/residence country; CHN is separate from HKG, MAC and TWN.
field_definitions.Origin ISO: Previous residence for mig_prev; birthplace for stock_mean and mig_brth.
field_definitions.Year: Annual model time coordinate; 2024 is a terminal stock year only.
field_definitions.mig_brth: Modelled birthplace-destination moves; origin field here means birthplace, not departure.
field_definitions.mig_brth_std: Publisher's standard deviation of the birthplace-destination flow estimate.
field_definitions.mig_prev: Modelled origin-destination moves by previous residence; use this for geographic direction.
field_definitions.mig_prev_std: Publisher's standard deviation; not a 95% confidence bound.
field_definitions.stock_mean: Modelled resident stock by birthplace, NOT annual immigration.
field_definitions.stock_std: Publisher's standard deviation of the resident-stock estimate.

limitations: Estimates, not observed administrative counts or permanent-residence grants.
Not restricted to U.S. citizens or mainland-China-born migrants.
Do not fill the missing FY2003-2005 official LPR arrivals with these values.
Do not append these estimates to the official fiscal-year LPR series.
